# graphiant_site_devices (Data Source)

Per-site device list with maintenance/VRRP/staging state. This is the closest real proxy for "site health" in the API — there is no dedicated site-health endpoint (V1SitesDetailsGet's "site wide status" doc comment does not correspond to any actual response field).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_site_devices" "hq" {
  site_id = graphiant_site.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `devices` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (Number)
- `hostname` (String)
- `location` (String)
- `maintenance_mode` (Boolean)
- `management_ip` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `role` (String)
- `serial_number` (String)
- `software_version` (String)
- `staging_mode` (Boolean)
- `vrrp_interface` (String)
- `vrrp_state` (String)
